execution.description: Derived GRAPHITE-GRANT-PHASE4 and built the Attacker's per-run budget from it.

expected: The grant's run cost splits into the owner's 1.48 of pods and 1.93 of tokens.
observed: #504's phase3_budget reserves twelve pods a session (2.96), leaving only 0.45 of tokens; the Attacker's worst case is six verify pods, so the driver rebuilds the budget at six pods to reach the owner-approved 1.48 pods and 1.93 tokens.
keep: Money binds, not a pod count: the grant's run cost is the cap, the six-pod figure only derives the token share.
The Attacker's model-call money cap is the token share; the verify pods' share stays reserved while Carbon's verify-pod rebuild is a declared NOT_RUN seam (no pod is launched in phase 4).
change: A phase-4 budget uses the Attacker's verify-pod count, not the Constructor's session-pod count.
